lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the branchial region, forming approximately four visible horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spots, forming a regular lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with lighter pixels above and a shadowed region below.

other_distinctive_markers: A high density of smaller, high-luminance spots localized on the dorsal surface and leading edge of the pectoral fin.
